fiat_currency.description: Fiat amounts shown on history use the current bitcoin price, not the price at the time of the transaction

backup_warning.title: Seed phrase alone is not enough
backup_warning.description: Your seed phrase recovers wallet keys but not your VTXOs. To fully restore on a fresh device, you must also continuously back up the wallet data directory at {{path}}.

community_forum.label: Community forum
community_forum.description: Ask questions and discuss with other users

community_chat.label: Community chat
community_chat.description: Join the chat for real-time conversation

emergency_exit.label: Emergency exit all
emergency_exit.description: Use only when the Ark server is unresponsive. Requires multiple on-chain transactions—ensure you have on-chain bitcoin to cover the fees.

confirm.title: Emergency exit all?
confirm.description: This unilaterally exits every VTXO back on-chain. The process is slow because it waits on Bitcoin timelocks and pays on-chain fees from your on-chain balance, and cannot be cancelled once started. Ensure your on-chain wallet has enough bitcoin for fees and double-check the destination address that will receive the funds once exits are claimable.

edit.title: Change destination address
edit.description: Update the address that will receive the swept funds once exit outputs are claimable.

emergency_exit.address_help: Funds will be swept to this address when exits become claimable.

estimate.title: Estimated total cost
estimate.hint: Rough upper-bound estimate. Actual cost depends on confirmation timing and on-chain congestion.
estimate.insufficient: Not enough on-chain bitcoin for estimated fees. Deposit more before starting.

delete_wallet.label: Delete wallet
delete_wallet.description: Deletes this wallet and creates a new one. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Delete this wallet?
confirm.description: Your current wallet will be deleted and a fresh wallet will be created. Make sure you have backed up your wallet first.

chart.title: Balance Over Time
chart.empty_description: Your balance over time will appear here once you start using the wallet.
